import pandas as pd

# Define source file paths exactly as given
source_files = [
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_42/test_0.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_42/test_1.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_42/test_2.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_42/test_3.csv"
]

# Step 1: Load all source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the first numerical index column
dfs = [pd.read_csv(f, index_col=0) for f in source_files]

# Step 2: Concatenate (UNION) all source tables since they share the same schema
df_all = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

# Step 3: Clean and preprocess columns to match target schema types

# Fill NaN in 'location' with empty string to avoid issues in encoding
df_all['location'] = df_all['location'].fillna('')

# Encode 'location' as categorical codes starting from 1
df_all['location'] = df_all['location'].astype('category').cat.codes + 1

# Columns to encode as categorical codes (integer codes starting from 1)
categorical_cols = ['title', 'company', 'summary', 'href', 'org_salary_period']
for col in categorical_cols:
    df_all[col] = df_all[col].fillna('')
    df_all[col] = df_all[col].astype('category').cat.codes + 1

# Convert 'salary', 'rate', 'reviews' to numeric and then to int

# 'salary' may be float or int, convert safely
df_all['salary'] = pd.to_numeric(df_all['salary'], errors='coerce').fillna(0).round().astype(int)

# 'rate' may be float or int, convert safely
df_all['rate'] = pd.to_numeric(df_all['rate'], errors='coerce').fillna(0).round().astype(int)

# 'reviews' may contain commas or strings, remove commas and convert
df_all['reviews'] = df_all['reviews'].astype(str).str.replace(',', '', regex=False)
df_all['reviews'] = pd.to_numeric(df_all['reviews'], errors='coerce').fillna(0).round().astype(int)

# Step 4: Group by 'location' and aggregate as specified
agg_dict = {
    'title': 'count',
    'company': 'count',
    'summary': 'count',
    'salary': 'mean',
    'href': 'count',
    'rate': 'mean',
    'reviews': 'mean',
    'org_salary_period': 'count'
}

df_grouped = df_all.groupby('location', as_index=False).agg(agg_dict)

# Step 5: Round mean aggregations to int to match target schema
df_grouped['salary'] = df_grouped['salary'].round().astype(int)
df_grouped['rate'] = df_grouped['rate'].round().astype(int)
df_grouped['reviews'] = df_grouped['reviews'].round().astype(int)

# Step 6: Reorder columns to match target schema order
target_columns = ['location', 'title', 'company', 'summary', 'salary', 'href', 'rate', 'reviews', 'org_salary_period']
df_target = df_grouped[target_columns]

# Step 7: Write the result to the specified output path
output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_42/target_multisource_critique_history.csv"
